title: Message envelope
description: Transport metadata shared by every message on the broker. The payload lives in `data` and is defined per message type.

messageId.description: Unique per message. Duplicates of the same message carry the same id.

source.description: Logical name of the producing service.

correlationId.description: Shared by all messages that belong to one routine execution.

causationId.description: messageId of the message that caused this one.
